ae.cfg.set.toggle.tip.EnglishUS:
On: the {SET} set (augmentations, chip, crate) is allowed to spawn in the save. Off: the set is no longer allowed to spawn in the save.

Toggling this option will only affect missions generated after the toggle has been turned on or off. Toggling the set off does not remove the items from the save, it only removes their ability to spawn. If turned off, next time the game is restarted the set's settings will vanish. Turning it on and restarting will make them come back.
ae.cfg.set.toggle.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启：{SET} 套装（义体、芯片、箱子）可以在此存档中生成。关闭：该套装不再在此存档中生成。

此选项只影响切换之后生成的任务。关闭套装不会移除存档中已有的物品，只会阻止它们生成。关闭后，下次重启游戏时该套装的设置会隐藏；重新开启并重启后会恢复。

ae.cfg.set.toggle.nochip.tip.EnglishUS:
On: the {SET} set (augmentations, crate) is allowed to spawn in the save. Off: the set is no longer allowed to spawn in the save.

Toggling this option will only affect missions generated after the toggle has been turned on or off. Toggling the set off does not remove the items from the save, it only removes their ability to spawn. If turned off, next time the game is restarted the set's settings will vanish. Turning it on and restarting will make them come back.
ae.cfg.set.toggle.nochip.tip.ChineseSimp:
开启：{SET} 套装（义体、箱子）可以在此存档中生成。关闭：该套装不再在此存档中生成。

此选项只影响切换之后生成的任务。关闭套装不会移除存档中已有的物品，只会阻止它们生成。关闭后，下次重启游戏时该套装的设置会隐藏；重新开启并重启后会恢复。

ae.cfg.merc.toggle.tip.ChineseSimp: 开启：Metabolic Energy Replacement Core（M.E.R.C.）会在 Dilthey 科技等级 3 生成

ae.cfg.augtech.tip.EnglishUS: Tech level of the nine augmentations of this set. This is what decides when the pieces can start showing up in missions: on enemies, in containers and in the loot on the ground. It is separate from the chip, so the pieces keep spawning even when the chip faction is none.
ae.cfg.augtech.tip.ChineseSimp: 该套装九件义体的科技等级。它决定这些部件何时开始在任务中出现：敌人身上、容器中以及地上的战利品。它与芯片分开设置，因此即使芯片阵营为 none，部件仍会继续生成。

ae.cfg.augtech.nochip.tip.EnglishUS: Tech level of the nine augmentations of this set. This is what decides when the pieces can start showing up in missions: on enemies, in containers and in the loot on the ground.
ae.cfg.augtech.nochip.tip.ChineseSimp: 该套装九件义体的科技等级。它决定这些部件何时开始在任务中出现：敌人身上、容器中以及地上的战利品。

ae.cfg.cratefaction.tip.EnglishUS: Faction that gives the crate as a mission reward. Pick none to remove it. The crate is a container: take it apart and it drops pieces of this set. It is never found lying around and never sold in a station, a mission reward is the only way to get one.
ae.cfg.cratefaction.tip.ChineseSimp: 作为任务奖励发放箱子的阵营。选择 none 可将其移除。箱子是一个容器：拆解后会得到该套装的部件。它不会出现在地上，也不会在空间站出售，只能通过任务奖励获得。

ae.cfg.cratetech.tip.EnglishUS: Crate tech level. The higher it is, the later the crate shows up in the chosen techtree as a reward. If the selected faction is none, it will not be rewarded after a mission.
ae.cfg.cratetech.tip.ChineseSimp: 箱子的科技等级。数值越高，箱子作为奖励出现在所选科技树中的时间越晚。如果所选阵营为 none，任务结束后不会奖励箱子。

ae.cfg.craftchip.tip.EnglishUS: On: you can craft {SET}'s chip in the HIS Magnum. Off: the chip is uncraftable and can only be found as a reward or in a mission.
ae.cfg.craftchip.tip.ChineseSimp: 开启：可以在 HIS Magnum 中制作 {SET} 的芯片。关闭：该芯片无法制作，只能作为奖励或在任务中获得。

ae.cfg.chipfaction.tip.EnglishUS: Faction that hands out the chip as a mission reward. Pick none to keep it out of the reward tables.
ae.cfg.chipfaction.tip.ChineseSimp: 作为任务奖励发放芯片的阵营。选择 none 可将其排除在奖励表之外。

ae.cfg.chiptech.tip.EnglishUS: Chip tech level. The higher it is, the later the chip shows up in the chosen techtree as a reward. If the selected faction is none, the chip is not rewarded after a mission and does not spawn at all.
ae.cfg.chiptech.tip.ChineseSimp: 芯片的科技等级。数值越高，芯片作为奖励出现在所选科技树中的时间越晚。如果所选阵营为 none，任务结束后不会奖励芯片，芯片也完全不会生成。

ae.cfg.uhmg.toggle.tip.EnglishUS: On: enables spawn of the (Arm+Chest) UHMG O'Dakka on Military, PMC and Merc enemies, and in Planetbridge TL6, Tianming TL6 and RealWare TL7

ae.cfg.gunarm.mode.tip.EnglishUS:
How the gun arms of this mod work. Vanilla: the arm blocks the primary weapon slot, like the vanilla weapon arms. Extra slot: the arm blocks the primary weapon slot and opens the third weapon slot. Bare hands only: no slot is blocked or added, the arm only replaces your bare hands weapon.

Arms that are already installed switch mode when the save is loaded. A weapon in the primary slot is moved to the backpack or vest when the slot gets blocked, and the switch waits until there is room for it.

(Arm+Chest) UHMG O'Dakka is not affected: it always blocks the primary weapon slot and replaces your bare hands weapon, like the vanilla weapon arms.
ae.cfg.gunarm.mode.tip.ChineseSimp:
本模组枪械手臂的工作方式。Vanilla：手臂会占用主武器栏，与原版武器手臂相同。Extra slot：手臂占用主武器栏，并开启第三武器栏。Bare hands only：不占用也不增加任何武器栏，手臂只替换你的徒手武器。

已安装的手臂会在读取存档时切换模式。主武器栏被占用时，其中的武器会被移到背包或背心；如果没有空间，切换会等到有空间为止。

ae.cfg.modconfig.note.EnglishUS: FROM HERE YOU CAN CHANGE THE MOD CONFIG FOR EACH SET AND SETLESS ITEM ADDED BY AUGMENTATIONS EXPANDED.

ae.cfg.restart.note.EnglishUS: REMEMBER TO RESTART THE GAME FOR ANY CHANGE MADE IN THIS MENU TO TAKE EFFECT

ae.cfg.vaclipping.tip.EnglishUS:
Requires Visible Augments.

Off: worn body armour, leggings, and boots are hidden in order to display the augment visuals.
On: restore Visible Augments' original clothing rules, allowing augments to overlap equipped armour.
Applies to both vanilla and AE visible augments.

ae.cfg.handfootrecipe.label.EnglishUS: Hand and foot required in recipes

ae.cfg.handfootrecipe.tip.EnglishUS:
On: crafting the arm of a set (shoulder and arm in one piece) needs the hand of the same set, and crafting the leg (thigh and foot in one piece) needs the foot of the same set, like the vanilla limbs. Off: the hand and the foot are removed from those recipes, so the arm and the leg are crafted from parts only.

Applies to every set that can be crafted: Adam Smasher, Nachtreiher, SCOUT-22 and NEMESIS. ANDRAS cannot be crafted.

ae.cfg.rankrestriction.tip.EnglishUS:
On: your clones can install the pieces of a set only once they reach the Minimum clone rank chosen in that set's section. Until then the Augment command of the piece is greyed out, and its tooltip shows the rank it needs. Off: any clone can install any piece, and the Minimum clone rank of the sets is ignored.

Only your clones are affected: enemies keep spawning with the pieces as before. Pieces already installed are not removed.

ae.cfg.multislotloss.tip.EnglishUS:
On: vanilla behaviour. If a clone loses one wound slot of a multi-woundslot augmentation to an amputation, the whole augmentation is destroyed at the end of the mission, and the implants on its other wound slots go back to the cargo.
Off (default): at the end of the mission the amputated wound slot grows back and the augmentation stays installed. The implants that were on the amputated wound slot are lost, since they fell to the ground or were destroyed with it; the implants on the other wound slots of the augmentation stay installed. The clone still needs the usual healing time for the amputation.

Only the items tagged as Multi-WoundSlot are affected:

ae.cfg.minrank.tip.EnglishUS: Lowest rank a clone needs to install the pieces of the {SET} set. It only takes effect when Clone rank restriction is on in GENERAL SETS TOGGLES. The ranks are read from the game, so ranks added by other mods are listed too.

ae.cfg.pmc.tip.EnglishUS:
On: the nine pieces of the {SET} set can also spawn on enemies with the PMC tag (PMC soldiers, heavy PMC, assassins and bounty hunters), on top of the tags and the preferred faction the set already has. Off: those enemies only carry the pieces when another tag of the set matches them.

Toggling this option will only affect missions generated after the change.

ae.tooltip.longstats.EnglishUS:
This Augment's effect list is too long to be displayed correctly, install it on your clone to see the effects for each woundslot!

 -Augmentations Expanded

ae.tooltip.multislot.EnglishUS: This item is tagged as Multi-WoundSlot

ae.icons.adaptive.tip.EnglishUS:
On: with an icon pack, the inventory size of an item follows its art: an icon up to 24 pixels wide takes 1 cell, a wider one takes 2. Off (default): every item keeps its standard size whatever the art, 2x1 for the set pieces, the gun arms and the crates, 1x1 for M.E.R.C. and the chips. Items drawn with the default art always keep their standard size.

Items already in your save keep the size they had when you got them: an augment takes the new size only after you install it on a clone and remove it again, because the removed piece is a new copy. Crates and chips you already own keep their old size. After the restart, new drops, crafts and rewards take the new size.

The game must be restarted for this option to take effect.

ae.icons.items.set.tip.EnglishUS: Textures of the nine pieces and of the crate of {NAME}: inventory icon, ground icon and ground shadow. With Adaptive inventory size on, the inventory size follows the icon pack art (see that option at the top).

ae.icons.items.item.tip.EnglishUS: Textures of {NAME}: inventory icon, ground icon and ground shadow. With Adaptive inventory size on, the inventory size follows the icon pack art (see that option at the top).

ae.icons.woundslots.tip.EnglishUS: Body part images of {NAME} on the augmentation and health screens, in all four states: normal, wounded, fixated and amputated.

ae.icons.chip.tip.EnglishUS: Textures of the chip of {NAME}: inventory icon, ground icon and ground shadow. With Adaptive inventory size on, the inventory size follows the icon pack art (see that option at the top).

ae.icons.weapon.set.tip.EnglishUS: Inventory icon of the fist that the arm and the hand of {NAME} put in the hand slot, shown there and in the current weapon panel. With Default - Foxyla36 the fist keeps the vanilla icon it uses now.

ae.icons.weapon.item.tip.EnglishUS: Inventory icon of the weapon that {NAME} puts in the hand slot, shown there and in the current weapon panel.

ae.icons.common.tip.EnglishUS:
Default - Foxyla36 is the art used now. A Custom - {author} entry only shows up when that icon pack has art for this entry, and any file the pack lacks keeps the default art.

The new icons are applied after a restart.

ae.cfg.set.toggle.nocrate.tip.EnglishUS:
On: the {SET} set (augmentation, chip) is allowed to spawn in the save. Off: the set is no longer allowed to spawn in the save.

Toggling this option will only affect missions generated after the toggle has been turned on or off. Toggling the set off does not remove the items from the save, it only removes their ability to spawn. If turned off, next time the game is restarted the set's settings will vanish. Turning it on and restarting will make them come back.

ae.cfg.augtech.single.tip.EnglishUS: Tech level of the augmentation. This is what decides when it can start showing up in missions: on enemies, in containers and in the loot on the ground, and from which tech level its reward faction hands it out. It is separate from the chip, so the augmentation keeps spawning even when the chip faction is none.

ae.cfg.rewardfaction.tip.EnglishUS: Faction that hands out the augmentation as a mission reward, from the augmentation's tech level. It takes the place of a crate, which this set does not have. Pick none to keep it out of the reward tables.
